character.description: Omo, an original chibi kitten who walks upright: soft charcoal-gray fur with no stripes, white muzzle, white chest and white paw tips, big round amber eyes, tiny pink nose, pointed ears with pink inner ear, long tail with a white tip, mint-green knitted scarf with a small white ring stitched on its end, small orange sneakers
